name: CM Process Solutions LLC
old_description: Dump buggy tumblers have been specifically designed to revolutionize mixing processes in food, beverage and pharmaceutical manufacturing, our dump buggy tumbler offers high quality consistent and safe mixing of products such as pasta salads, RTE (ready to eat) meals and protein products like chicken, ribs, and pork loins.
about:
CM Process Solutions LLC operates from Winchester, Kentucky, where it designs and builds stainless‑steel hygienic equipment for food, beverage and pharmaceutical processors. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials, and no founders are named on its website.

The product line centers on dump‑buggy tumblers — notably the TT3 model — that mix, coat, marinate, infuse and blend products such as pasta salads, ready‑to‑eat meals, chicken, ribs, pork loins and pet‑food kibble. A bi‑directional rotation system replaces paddles or blades, and a vacuum‑assist option accelerates marination of muscle meats and pulled pork. The portfolio also includes lifting and dumping systems and industrial washing equipment, all fabricated from stainless steel. A newly commissioned demonstration center allows customers to trial equipment before purchase, and the company supplies after‑sales support and spare parts.

Customers span North America’s hygiene‑conscious sectors: meat and poultry processors, prepared‑meal manufacturers, beverage plants and pet‑food producers. CM Process Solutions holds associate memberships in the Food Production Solutions Association, PMMI (The Association for Packaging & Processing Technologies), the American Association of Meat Processors and the U.S. Poultry & Egg Association, reflecting its focus on protein and packaged‑food markets.

The company positions itself as a market leader in hygienic equipment innovation, emphasizing custom‑engineered designs developed in close collaboration with each client’s engineering and production teams. The on‑site demonstration center is cited as a key differentiator, enabling real‑world process validation prior to capital commitment.
